note: One row per encoder version, in the order measured. A row is never edited. A correction is a new row with a note saying what the earlier row got wrong. Numbers are what the instrument printed at the time, on the frozen corpus, and each was confirmed on a second platform where the 'confirmed' field says so.

rows.note: Before local bindings were represented. Opaque reasons were grammar node names at this version, not categories, which was itself a defect fixed at IR-2.
Local bindings and assignments as named values. Member reads added later the same day (IR-1b) took the groups from 5 to 4.
Language-neutral opaque categories and canonical single-use inlining. First version confirmed on a second platform.
Calls and other expressions in operand position as computed values.
A function passed as a value represented as behaviour. The two groups are the switch-heavy group and block in both adapters, which is the one genuine cross-language match in this corpus.
